system.description: Somehow you've developed the ability to store more blood in yourself than is normal for your generation. You are a fat little sausage saturated with vitae, and your skin is strained and partially split whenever you are full. Every point in this Merit increases your capacity to carry blood by one extra point above your generation maximum. You have a larger reservoir, but you cannot process or expend the vitae any quicker than your peers can. Whenever you are fully fed, your skin is a ruddy color and other Cainites can smell the blood trying to squeeze past your pores (a Perception + Alertness roll, difficulty 7, notices this), which can cause frenzies in hungered vampires.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
